name: com.undocsend/docs
title: undocsend docs
description: Search and read the undocsend docs, pricing and security pages. Public, read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the undocsend documentation, plus the features, pricing and security pages. Returns ranked pages with title, path, HTML URL, markdown URL and a snippet. Follow up with get_doc to read a page.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. "require an NDA before viewing" or "watermark".

limit.description: How many results to return (1-20, default 5).

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return one undocsend docs page (or /features, /pricing, /security) as markdown. The path must be one returned by search_docs or list_docs.

path.description: A docs path from search_docs or list_docs, e.g. "/docs/agreements/ndas" or "/pricing". A full undocsend.com URL or a .md URL also works.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: The undocsend docs table of contents: every section and page with its path, URLs and a one-line description.
